new.s: What did the Andhra Pradesh Government create in November 2022 to deal exclusively with climate change?

Which of the above are identified as vulnerable to climate hazards in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Heatwaves, droughts, floods and cyclones put water, agriculture, food security and health at risk in Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: What is the full form of NAFCC?
o: National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change
National Action Fund for Clean Climate
National Agency for Forest and Climate Change
National Adaptation Framework for Coastal Communities
new.x: NAFCC is the National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change (2015); NABARD is its National Implementing Entity.

new.s: What is the full form of PAT, the market mechanism under the National Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency?
new.x: PAT stands for Perform, Achieve and Trade; units that beat their targets earn tradable Energy Saving Certificates.

new.s: Which is the nodal ministry for the National Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency?
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

new.s: Where was CoP30, at which India delivered its National Statement on 17 November 2025, held?
new.x: CoP30 was held at Belem in Brazil; India gave its National Statement there on 17 November 2025.

new.s: Which heavy metals are found in coal ash, whose disposal pollutes soil?
o: Arsenic, mercury, lead, cadmium and chromium
new.x: Coal ash carries toxic heavy metals such as arsenic, mercury, lead, cadmium and chromium into the soil.

new.s: Which of the following is a source of mercury pollution?
new.x: Mercury is released by coal combustion, smelters and chemical effluents.

new.s: Where is the Wildlife Institute of India (WII) located?
new.x: WII, the wildlife research and training body, is at Dehradun, like FRI and ICFRE.

new.s: In which year was the Bombay Natural History Society (BNHS) founded?
new.x: BNHS, based in Mumbai, was founded in 1883; 1906 is FRI, 1958 is NEERI and 1982 is IIFM.

new.s: Which city of Andhra Pradesh was assessed under the Comprehensive Environmental Pollution Index (CEPI)?
new.x: Visakhapatnam is the AP industrial cluster assessed under CEPI.

new.s: Which national programme was launched by the MoEFCC in January 2019 to cut particulate pollution in non-attainment cities?
o: System of Air Quality and Weather Forecasting (SAFAR)
new.x: NCAP was launched in January 2019 by the MoEFCC as a time-bound national strategy for cleaner air.

new.s: How does carbon monoxide from vehicle exhaust harm the body?
o: It forms carboxyhaemoglobin and cuts oxygen supply
new.x: CO binds haemoglobin to form carboxyhaemoglobin, so the blood carries less oxygen.

new.s: In which city of the then Andhra Pradesh were BS-III norms first applied on 1 April 2005?

new.x: A DPF traps soot from diesel exhaust and burns it off; SCR handles NOx and OBD-II monitors emissions.

new.s: Which contaminant in drinking water causes blue baby syndrome?
new.x: Excess nitrate causes blue baby syndrome in infants, as the blood cannot carry enough oxygen.

new.s: What is the medical name of blue baby syndrome?
new.x: Blue baby syndrome is methaemoglobinaemia, caused by nitrate in drinking water.

new.s: Knock-knee syndrome (genu valgum) is a form of which disease?
new.x: Knock-knee is a skeletal fluorosis, seen when fluoride is above 0.5 ppm for 5-10 years.

new.s: What was India's rank in the water quality index cited in NITI Aayog's Composite Water Management Index 2018?
new.x: CWMI 2018 cited India at 120th of 122 countries in water quality, from the UN World Water Development Report.

new.s: Under which programme are the Bhoj (Madhya Pradesh), Sukhna (Chandigarh) and Pichola (Rajasthan) lakes being conserved?

o: South Asian Council for Environmental Protection
